host: disposable one-CPU ARM64 Linux VM, kernel 7.2.7-200.fc44.aarch64
method: The observer paused a forked helper before PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, killed and reaped its parent, then allowed the helper to set the signal. The helper compared getppid with the saved parent in the first case; the control omitted that comparison. The dedicated VM was stopped and removed.
scope: This one-off Python kernel experiment demonstrates the already-dead-parent race and a possible detection mechanism. It does not execute the changed Kotoba runtime, cover all scheduling races, prove process-tree cleanup or qualify a governor.
